rerun_command: pytest  (from the project root, with the project venv)

metadata.purpose: 2D mode must be unreachable, Native3D mode must be reachable

wall_in_plane_separation.wall_covers_y: wall y range [-50, 350] contains chip y range [0, 300]
wall_in_plane_separation.argument: in the z = 0 plane the wall plus the chip boundary separates the source region x <= 285 from the target region x >= 315; nothing in that plane connects them

search.reason: goal state popped with minimal f=495.301313573 after 27 expansions

reference_graph.note: finite canonical reference graph: nodes are canonical poses, edges are exact Dubins connectors ending on canonical poses; optimality is claimed for THIS finite graph only

no_optical_loss_model: this engine computes geometry only; no dB, no insertion loss and no crosstalk number is produced

boundary.method: exact analytic coordinate extrema per segment (no chord error, no sampling)

obstacle_clearance.method: exact segment/segment and segment/AABB distance for lines; adaptive chord subdivision with an explicit sagitta bound for arcs; sampled minima are upper bounds only

centerline_spacing.method: exact segment/segment distance for line/line pairs; adaptive chord subdivision with explicit sagitta bounds when an arc is involved; sampled minima are upper bounds only

finite_difference_cross_check.note: central difference at +-1e-3 um; agreement within the chord error 1e-3/R rad confirms the analytic tangents

certification.notes: pass = every check was certified safe; fail = a violation witness or an analytically exceeded boundary; uncertified = a check could not be decided inside the refinement cap (never reported as pass)
